from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
import pandas as pd
b=Path('reports/research/510300_fund_quarterly_aggregate_exposure_joint_cases_v1')
def readj(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert not (b/'next_experiment.json').exists()
memberpath=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_last_period_government_full_quantity_anchor_v1/全部1711原成员_完整原载体保守公开支持.csv')
scorepath=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_joint_nonlinear_score_v1/每日工业多维非线性共同评分.csv')
members=pd.read_csv(memberpath,usecols=['idx','date','decision_time'])
scores=pd.read_csv(scorepath,usecols=['idx','date'])
assert len(members)==1711 and len(scores)==1212
old=Path('reports/research/510300_original_fund_subscription_reports_v1/quarterly_fact_records_v1_1')
catalog=[]
for file in sorted(old.glob('*.json')):
 d=readj(file)
 if d.get('clock',{}).get('source_usable'):
  catalog.append({'quarter':d['period'],'available_session':d['clock']['feature_available_session'],
   'fact_receipt':str(file).replace('\\','/'),'fact_receipt_sha256':sha(file),'pdf_path':d['source']['raw_path'],
   'pdf_sha256_from_original_receipt':d['source']['sha256'],'catalog_publication_date':d['source']['publication_date']})
catalog.sort(key=lambda x:x['available_session'])
selections=[]
for role,frame in [('ORIGINAL_1711_MEMBER',members),('ORIGINAL_1212_SCORE_DATE',scores)]:
 for row in frame.itertuples(index=False):
  day=str(row.date)[:10]
  prior=[x for x in catalog if x['available_session']<=day]
  chosen=prior[-1] if prior else None
  selections.append({'role':role,'idx':int(row.idx),'date':day,'chosen_original_quarter':chosen['quarter'] if chosen else 'UNKNOWN',
   'available_session':chosen['available_session'] if chosen else 'UNKNOWN'})
needed=set(x['chosen_original_quarter'] for x in selections if x['chosen_original_quarter']!='UNKNOWN')
selected=[x for x in catalog if x['quarter'] in needed]
parents=[b/'protocol.json',b/'result.json',memberpath,scorepath,
 Path('reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/共同成熟训练池.json')]
p={'experiment_id':'E105','status':'PROPOSED_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN','proposed_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),
 'question':'三例基金整体行业暴露可在原时点公开；下一只用已存原报告把有年龄的季度整体母体投影到全部原成员和评分时点，为原资金订单回款成本库存共同状态补一个不同信息范围。先补完整观察，不登记收益候选。',
 'hypothesis':'基金实际行业/金融/现金母体与全国工业总体不同；粗行业暴露随时间变化可改变共同约束的传导范围，但其自身不识别净股价方向。',
 'parents':[{'path':str(x).replace('\\','/'),'sha256':sha(x)} for x in parents],
 'fixed_original_members':1711,'fixed_original_score_dates':1212,
 'original_member_date_range':[str(members.date.min())[:10],str(members.date.max())[:10]],
 'original_score_date_range':[str(scores.date.min())[:10],str(scores.date.max())[:10]],
 'fixed_existing_report_count':len(selected),'fixed_existing_quarters':[x['quarter'] for x in selected],
 'existing_original_reports_selected_before_new_portfolio_values':selected,
 'selection_policy':'各原时点只取自己的上交所目录日期已知且沿原保守下一交易日可用的最近原季度报告；不读新收益、不换月救E103。无原目录/份额合并分母/行业表则UNKNOWN，不删除原时点。',
 'fixed_metadata_selection_path':str(b/'E105提案时仅元数据的原成员及评分日季度选择.csv').replace('\\','/'),
 'new_original_report_reads_max':len([x for x in selected if x['quarter'] not in ['2020Q3','2021Q2','2024Q1']]),
 'E104_three_original_extracts_reused_not_new_sources':True,
 'complete_source_gate_before_any_financial_candidate':'每份自己的原数量/分母/分类/目录钟；1711原成员和1212评分时点完整覆盖，原每个成熟池原成员身份保留。真正首版和独立验证仍未认证；粗基金源门不代原月末指数门或细煤/火电/装备映射。',
 'scope_policy':'原未拆境内股与后期指数/积极分开；净值与总资产分母、原破折号、正金额但0.00%及证券出借附注全保留；制造内部异质/金融与服务/观察年龄并列。不做个股选择/估值。',
 'budget':{'external_queries':0,'new_raw_GETs':0,'authenticated_requests':0,'request_retries':0,'new_financial_candidates':0,
 'new_model_fits':0,'new_linear_regressions':0,'new_simple_weighted_scores':0,'new_stock_labels':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0},
 'stop':'登记后对这组已存原报告各首次提取一次，E104原3表复用；缺原钟/表/分类保留UNKNOWN后结束，不加联网源、不删样本/补0/改窗口/阈值/模型/费用。',
 'E100_fixed_rejection_preserved':True,'E103_target_month_index_bridge_0_of_3_terminal_preserved':True,
 'old_quarterly_flow_failure_preserved':True,'fine_sector_pure_causal_mapping':'UNKNOWN','market_consensus_or_surprise':'UNKNOWN',
 'goal_achieved':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED'}
pd.DataFrame(selections).to_csv(b/'E105提案时仅元数据的原成员及评分日季度选择.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
(b/'next_experiment.json').write_text(json.dumps(p,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'next':'E105仅提案未登记执行','report_count':len(selected),'quarters':p['fixed_existing_quarters'],
 'original_member_range':p['original_member_date_range'],'original_score_range':p['original_score_date_range'],
 'previously_completed_source_tables':3,'new_reads_max':p['new_original_report_reads_max'],'network_budget':0,'fits_budget':0},ensure_ascii=False))
